title: podman machine os upgrade broken on 6
body:
trying the new command on 6.0 fails with
```
$ bin/podman machine os upgrade 
Error: unsupported OS
Error: exit status 125
```

The main problem is that we changed podman-machine-os to report its own variant and the code here was not updated. Because we do not yet have upgrade tests this was not caught.

comments.body: do you have a link to the PR that changed the variant?

@Luap99 - What is the way to upgrade the Podman machine from 6.0 to 6.1?

In https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29086, you mentioned that `podman machine apply` needs to be used. However, for me (on macOS) that results in the same error as the `podman machine upgrade` command.

```
% podman machine os apply quay.io/podman/machine-os:6.1.0 --restart
Error: unsupported OS
Error: exit status 125
```
untested but I think `podman machine ssh sudo bootc switch quay.io/podman/machine-os:6.1.0` should work. Note you need to stop and start machine afterwards
Thank you! `podman machine ssh sudo bootc switch quay.io/podman/machine-os:6.1` (without the trailing `.0`) did the trick.
ah yes of course, we only publish major.minor tags
